title: 7.2 How Are You?
unit_outcome: Talk about the body, feelings, clothes, the weather and seasons, free time and invitations, ask people to repeat or speak slowly, and name things outdoors, animals, sports and music in Spanish.
goal: Ask how someone is and answer: ¿Cómo estás? Estoy feliz. Tengo hambre.
grammar_function: ¿Cómo está…? estar + feliz/triste/cansado; tener + hambre/sed; Necesito…
speaking_outcome: Ask how someone is and answer: ¿Cómo estás? Estoy feliz. Tengo hambre.
